title.narrative: PROMOTING WOMEN and YOUTH PEACE AND SECURITY AGENDAS PROJECT - 01/10/24 TO 30/09/25

description.narrative: The Promoting the Women and Youth Peace and Security Agendas project in South Africa and the Southern Africa region, implemented by The Institute for Justice and Reconciliation aims to contribute to ensuring that societies are fair, inclusive, democratic and peaceful. The overall objectives of the grant are to consolidate the gains and advance the WPS agenda in South Africa and regionally and align with and compliment the implementation of the YPS agenda for the benefit of women and youth. The key activities include Intergenerational dialogues; stakeholder engagements with traditional women leaders and church leaders; stakeholder meetings for advocacy on WPS and collating inputs for New NAP; and research and documentation on WPS and YPS delivered in partnership with a consortium of civil society organisations.
